Connect an app in three steps
In Discover, pick an app and click “Add a connection”. It needs your Composio key or your Kybernos account.
A tab of the app opens: sign in and allow access.
It appears under Yours: your agents can now act in that app.

en: Choose the language of the interface. Texts that aren’t translated yet stay in English; plugin pages (skills, connectors, dashboards, chat chips) are translated the first time you open them, then kept.
Translate the interface in three steps
Open “Add a language” and pick one from the ISO list.
The progress bar shows how far it is. You can pause and resume at any time.
Kybernos and DSH switch to this language. To go back, use another language.
Texts not translated yet stay in English. It is the same choice as in Settings › General › Language.
